title: ID0422323-DC/Si-D/IT[170002654] - Faulty plugs
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
Outlets out of order due to Modbus timeout
Workaround:
Reboot
Solution
: Update EcoG to 1.4.11

Dear Filomena Carusone,
Thank you for reaching
out
to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / R9 170002654
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
m6Wiqu
Problem Description
: 2 of 3 plugs are faulty
Troubleshooting
: I checked the charger remotely and I see that it had a communication issue to the charging controllers. After a restart, it's working again.
What I propose is to install a hotfix for this particular issue where we increase the timeout since there is nothing wrong with the controller. It takes around 10-20mins to install everything.
If I have your permission I can install it as soon as possible. Since I'm one of the few people I can install, I can only do it until your 6pm.
If the issue is not resolved with the hotfix, then we will align with the regional colleagues for a deeper troubleshoot.
Let me know your feedback.
For future reference, your case number is
0422323
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim
